user.title: Add an address
user.description: Planned power outages and incidents of Distribuție Energie Electrică Romania (DEER) for one address. Type the locality in Romanian or in Hungarian (e.g. Târgu Secuiesc or Kézdivásárhely). Leave the streets empty to follow the whole locality.

data_description.streets: Example: Gábor Áron, Ady Endre. Outages that cover the whole locality or a zone are always included.
